name: safety-board
title: The safety board
subtitle: Health and Safety for Claude Code: what needs a decision, the open incidents and the actions. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Unreported notifiable events outrank everything (HSWA s 56). Then overdue actions, induction gaps, weak controls, stale reviews and quiet sites.
sections.sql: select case reason when 'notifiable_unreported' then 'NOTIFIABLE EVENT, WorkSafe not told' when 'action_overdue' then 'Corrective action overdue' when 'induction_missing' then 'No site induction' when 'induction_expired' then 'Induction expired' when 'hazard_uncontrolled' then 'High hazard, weak control' when 'hazard_review_overdue' then 'Hazard review overdue' when 'investigation_stale' then 'Investigation going stale' when 'inspection_overdue' then 'Inspection overdue' when 'sds_gap' then 'Safety data sheet gap' when 'training_expiring' then 'Ticket expiring' when 'toolbox_quiet' then 'Site quiet: no toolbox talk' else reason end as what, label as record, site, coalesce(owner, '') as owner, days, detail from v_attention order by case reason when 'notifiable_unreported' then 1 when 'action_overdue' then 2 when 'induction_missing' then 3 when 'induction_expired' then 4 when 'hazard_uncontrolled' then 5 when 'hazard_review_overdue' then 6 when 'investigation_stale' then 7 when 'inspection_overdue' then 8 when 'sds_gap' then 9 when 'training_expiring' then 10 else 11 end, days desc nulls last

sections.title: Open incidents
sections.note: Report, notify WorkSafe if notifiable, investigate, act, close. Nothing closes with WorkSafe untold or nothing changed.
sections.sql: select ref, site, kind, case when notifiable then 'YES' else '' end as notifiable, to_char(occurred_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as occurred, person as who, title as what, case when notifiable and worksafe_notified_on is null then 'NOT NOTIFIED' when worksafe_notified_on is not null then to_char(worksafe_notified_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else '' end as worksafe, status from v_incidents where status <> 'closed' order by occurred_on desc

sections.title: Open corrective actions
sections.note: An action written down and left overdue is a risk you knew about, dated, in your own records.
sections.sql: select title as action, source as from_what, site, owner, to_char(due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as due, case when days_to_due < 0 then abs(days_to_due) || ' days OVERDUE' when days_to_due is not null then days_to_due || ' days' else 'NO DATE' end as countdown from v_actions where status = 'open' order by due_on nulls last

sections.title: Toolbox talks
sections.note: Worker engagement is a duty (HSWA Part 3). A site quiet past a fortnight shows above.
sections.sql: select site, coalesce(to_char(last_talk_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'NEVER') as last_talk, coalesce(days_since || ' days ago', '') as when_was_that, led_by, coalesce(topic, '') as topic from v_toolbox order by days_since desc nulls first

name: registers
title: The registers
subtitle: Health and Safety for Claude Code: hazards by risk, inductions, substances and the inspection calendar. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: The hazard register, highest risk first
sections.note: Risk is likelihood x consequence on a 5x5: 1-4 low, 5-9 moderate, 10-16 high, 17-25 critical. High or critical on administration or PPE alone breaches the hierarchy (GRWM reg 6).
sections.sql: select ref, site, title as hazard, category, score || '/25 ' || band as risk, coalesce(control_level, 'NONE') as control_level, coalesce(controls, 'NONE RECORDED') as controls, owner, coalesce(to_char(review_due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as review_due, status from v_hazards where status <> 'closed' order by score desc

sections.title: Site inductions
sections.note: Everyone active on the tools, contractors included (overlapping duties, HSWA s 34).
sections.sql: select person, role, company, site as usual_site, coalesce(to_char(inducted_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as inducted, coalesce(to_char(expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as expires, induction as status from v_inductions order by case induction when 'MISSING' then 1 when 'EXPIRED' then 2 when 'expiring' then 3 else 4 end, person

sections.title: Hazardous substances inventory
sections.note: An inventory with a current SDS per substance is the Hazardous Substances Regulations 2017 floor. An SDS older than five years is stale.
sections.sql: select name as substance, site, coalesce(quantity, '') as quantity, coalesce(location, '') as location, coalesce(to_char(sds_dated_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as sds_dated, sds as sds_status from v_substances where status = 'in_use' order by case sds when 'MISSING' then 1 when 'STALE' then 2 else 3 end, name

sections.title: The inspection calendar
sections.sql: select site, kind, coalesce(to_char(due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as due, case when status = 'due' and days_to_due < 0 then abs(days_to_due) || ' days OVERDUE' when status = 'due' and days_to_due is not null then days_to_due || ' days' else '' end as countdown, coalesce(to_char(done_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as done, done_by, coalesce(findings, '') as findings from v_inspections order by status desc, due_on nulls last
